title: Tandoori Chicken

items: 3 lbs Chicken (butterflied whole, assorted bone-in parts, or 1” boneless cubes)

steps: Add all the marinade ingredients to a large bowl and whisk to combine.

Prepare the chicken. For a whole chicken, butterfly it first. For whole or bone-in pieces, remove skin and excess fat and slash down to the bone about every inch. For kebabs, cut boneless chicken into 1–1½-inch cubes.
Add the chicken to the marinade, making sure to coat the surface and working the mixture into the slashes.
Cover the bowl and marinade in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours or overnight for the best results.
Right before grilling, remove excess marinade and skewer if applicable.
Grill over medium high heat, flipping and rotating every 3 minutes for 12-15 minutes, until a thermometer registers an internal temperature of 165 °F.
sourceNote: Adapted from Food Fusion, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6pOa9nESATY Garlic and Ginger Paste can be made by grinding equal portions in a mortar and pestle until a smooth paste forms.
